trust_decision.summary: Log-record properties (attacker-influenced) are rendered into the RFC 5424 frame as SD-PARAMs; the formatter decides which keys are valid SD-NAMEs and how values are escaped, in formatStructuredData/escapeStructuredDataValue of the syslog sink.

landing_point.why: The summary names unescaped control characters in structured data and SD-NAME keys; escapeStructuredDataValue and its caller formatStructuredData are the only SD code.

fix_sites.entry_point: getSyslogSink({includeStructuredData:true}) sink(record) -> formatSyslogMessage -> formatStructuredData -> escapeStructuredDataValue (value escaping, C0 -> #NNN)
same sink call; property-key emission without SD-NAME validation (fix adds isStructuredDataName skip)
same sink call; fix returns '-' when every key is skipped (fix.diff:196)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The advisory is titled and scoped to structured data under includeStructuredData; RFC 5424 MSG is free-form, so a solver can argue the message body is out of scope and must stay verbatim.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Existing escaping of backslash, quote and ']' in SD values must still round-trip, valid keys must still be emitted, and template-literal messages must render interpolated values as JSON verbatim; an over-broad fix (dropping/encoding the whole message, or rejecting non-ASCII values) breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: SD value with LF/CR/NUL and other C0 control characters (fix.diff:151-152)
SD value with backslash, quote, ']' (pre-existing, kept: fix.diff:153-158)
SD key containing space, '=', ']', '"', control chars, or non-ASCII (fix.diff:174-178)
SD key empty or longer than 32 chars (fix.diff:170)
all keys invalid -> '-' instead of an empty SD element (fix.diff:196)
non-string property values coerced via String(value) (packages/syslog/src/syslog.ts:233)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: MSG body: literal message parts (and plain-string messages) are concatenated raw into the frame, so LF/CR in a logged string split the TCP LF-framed stream into a forged frame; only interpolated values are JSON-escaped.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Advisory and fix only mention structured data; MSG is free-form per RFC 5424 and the fix's tests keep the message untouched.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, ~40 lines below the fix sites; framing that makes it exploitable is at packages/syslog/src/syslog.ts:552 and packages/syslog/src/syslog.ts:653

O8_uncovered_routes.route: structuredDataId option is inserted into the SD element without SD-ID validation.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Operator configuration, not log data; weak route.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same line as a fix site

O8b_injection_room.sibling: MSGID taken from a record property or category instead of the '-' constant, emitted without PRINTUSASCII/length validation
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The code already comments 'Could be enhanced to include message ID'; a maintainer would plausibly add it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second formatter (e.g. RFC 3164 / BSD format option) rendering properties as key=value without the new escaping
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Many syslog sinks offer a legacy 3164 mode; it would be a second implementation of the same rendering.

O9_family: log injection / CRLF injection into syslog frames (CWE-117, CWE-93)

O10_build.toolchain: Deno (deno test) with Node/pnpm workspace support
O10_build.project_tests: packages/syslog/src/syslog.test.ts uses local UDP/TCP servers on 127.0.0.1 (e.g. packages/syslog/src/syslog.test.ts:885-895); Deno and Node branches

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add \n/\r to the escape chain in escapeStructuredDataValue and stop, leaving keys unvalidated and the MSG body raw.

out_of_scope_notes: Other sinks in the monorepo (e.g. packages/windows-eventlog, packages/cloudwatch-logs) may render properties similarly; not examined.
fix.diff:205-206 also changes a Deno timeoutId type; not security-relevant.
unverified: repo_mb not measured; the affected package is a single ~860-line file, so the effective surface is small and tiny_repo may apply to the task surface even if the monorepo exceeds 5 MB.
Whether maintainers consider the MSG-body CRLF route in scope is not documented; latest code was not available, so present_in_latest is unknown.
j_defence_ineffective=1 reflects the existing partial escaping (backslash/quote/']') that missed control chars and keys.
